reuse.why: Calls the existing exported getScheduledAmount with the raw amount, which already covers missing, single and ranged values, instead of re-deriving the rule.

duplication.why: Adds no logic of its own; the rule stays in shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API shape of a schedule is built.

scope.why: One import, one type field and one mapped property.

maintainability.why: Minimal and follows the existing helper, so a future rule change flows to the API automatically.
